title: The Downside of AI Coding No One Talks About
description:
hy do developers hit a wall at four AI agents? Because context, not model choice, is the bottleneck. AI coding has evolved beyond writing: it's about specifying, managing, and training development skills. This transition marks a shift from spec-driven to context-driven development.

What we cover:
• The transition from spec-driven to context-driven development
• How do agents change the code review process?
• Understanding human bottlenecks in the software development lifecycle
• Unlocking AI integration across organizations
• Why context is everything in modern DevOps
